subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Should outbound WhatsApp stickers accept only caller-prepared valid sticker media, or should OpenClaw also convert ordinary images into WhatsApp-compatible stickers?
rationale: Current main settles the Baileys transport primitive but not the public media contract; conversion materially expands dependencies, animation and metadata requirements, errors, and user expectations.

options.title: Validate prepared stickers
options.body: Wire explicit sticker intent to the existing sender and reject unsupported media with actionable errors, leaving conversion to callers or dedicated tools.

options.title: Convert arbitrary images
options.body: Add a supported static and animated conversion pipeline, including metadata handling and real-client compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Validate prepared stickers
recommendation.body: Wire explicit sticker intent to the existing sender and reject unsupported media with actionable errors, leaving conversion to callers or dedicated tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The central WhatsApp send and action paths have the strongest recent history under this contributor, and the issue already received product-boundary review from the same person.
